questions.title: Search Value Position
questions.description:
Finding a value in a linked list means following next pointers until the value appears. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int find(Node head, int target)

It must return the 0-based index of the FIRST node holding target, or -1 when the value is absent.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order. Line 3: the target.

Output Format:
One line with the index or -1.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value, target <= 1000

questions.title: Count Value Occurrences
questions.description:
A linked list can hold duplicates; counting them still needs a full walk. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int count(Node head, int target)

It must return how many nodes in the list hold target.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order. Line 3: the target.

Output Format:
One line with the occurrence count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value, target <= 1000

questions.title: Reverse the List
questions.description:
Reversing pointers turns the whole list around in a single pass — the heart of linked-list manipulation. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static Node reverse(Node head)

It must reverse the list by rewiring the next pointers in place and return the new head. The harness prints the reversed values space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the values of the reversed list space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Nth Node from the Start
questions.description:
Access by position in a linked list means stepping over k-1 nodes — there is no index arithmetic. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int nthNode(Node head, int k)

It must return the value of the k-th node counting from the head (1-based). k is guaranteed to lie within the list.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order. Line 3: k.

Output Format:
One line with the value of the k-th node.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 1 <= k <= n, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: First Node of the Loop
questions.description:
A ticket-routing chain points back mid-chain; fixing it needs the exact node where the cycle begins — still with constant memory (Floyd's algorithm, phase two). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int cycleStart(Node head)

It must return the data of the node where the cycle starts, or -1 when there is no cycle.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order. Line 3: pos, the index the tail links back to (-1 means no cycle).

Output Format:
One line with the data of the cycle's first node, or -1.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1 <= pos < n, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Sorted Insert Position
questions.description:
A maintenance queue is kept sorted ascending; each new job must slide into its slot with a freshly linked node. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static Node insertSorted(Node head, int value)

It must insert value so the list stays ascending (after any equal values) and return the (possibly new) head. The harness prints the resulting list space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the sorted values. Line 3: the value to insert.

Output Format:
One line with the resulting list space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Detecting a Loop
questions.description:
A bug made a ride's queue point back on itself, so visitors loop forever. Detect the cycle with slow/fast pointers — constant extra memory, no hashing. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int hasCycle(Node head)

It must return 1 when the chain contains a cycle (Floyd's tortoise and hare) and 0 otherwise.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order. Line 3: pos, the index the tail links back to (-1 means no cycle).

Output Format:
One line with 1 or 0.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1 <= pos < n, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Count List Nodes
questions.description:
A singly linked list hides its size — the only way to count is to walk it. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int length(Node head)

It must return the number of nodes reachable from head.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of nodes. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the node count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Sum of Node Values
questions.description:
Accumulating a total across a linked list is the classic traversal drill. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int sum(Node head)

It must return the sum of all node values from head to the end of the list.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of nodes. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the sum.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Playlist Song Count
questions.description:
A streaming queue stores songs as nodes appended one by one — count them by walking the chain. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int length(Node head)

It must return the number of songs (nodes) in the queue.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of songs. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the song IDs in queue order.

Output Format:
One line with the number of songs.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 1 <= id <= 100000

questions.title: Shopping Cart Total
questions.description:
A checkout cart keeps item prices in a linked list; total them before payment. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int sum(Node head)

It must return the total of all prices in the cart.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of items. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the prices in cart order.

Output Format:
One line with the cart total.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= price <= 1000

questions.title: Undo History Replay
questions.description:
An undo buffer stores actions newest-first; replaying them in submission order means walking the chain backwards — reverse it first. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static Node reverse(Node head)

It must rewire the next pointers in place and return the new head. The harness prints the replay order space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of stored actions. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the action codes newest-first.

Output Format:
One line with the replay order space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= code <= 1000

questions.title: Train Carriage Lookup
questions.description:
A shunting yard lists carriage numbers in order; dispatch needs the position of one carriage. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int find(Node head, int target)

It must return the 0-based position of the first carriage numbered target, or -1 when it is not coupled in.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the carriage numbers in order. Line 3: the queried carriage number.

Output Format:
One line with the position or -1.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 1 <= number, target <= 100000

questions.title: Middle of the Queue
questions.description:
A support counter serves whoever stands in the middle of a queue stored as a linked list — without knowing n in advance. Send a fast pointer two steps for every one step of a slow pointer. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int middle(Node head)

It must return the value of the middle node; when the list holds an even number of nodes, return the SECOND of the two middle nodes.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the queue values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the middle value.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Remove One Faulty Record
questions.description:
One sensor log entry is corrupted; unlink its first occurrence and repair the chain around it. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static Node deleteFirst(Node head, int target)

It must unlink the FIRST node holding target (do nothing when absent) and return the head. The harness prints the resulting list space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the log values in order. Line 3: the value to remove.

Output Format:
One line with the resulting list space-separated (at least one node always survives).

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value, target <= 1000

questions.title: Distance from the End
questions.description:
A call centre reports the k-th last ticket without storing the length: a fast runner advances k nodes first, then both pointers walk together until the runner falls off the end. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int kthFromEnd(Node head, int k)

It must return the value of the k-th node from the end (1-based). k is guaranteed valid.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the ticket values in order. Line 3: k.

Output Format:
One line with the k-th value from the end.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 1 <= k <= n, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Insert into the Roster
questions.description:
A tournament roster inserts players at any slot; splice a fresh node in without disturbing the rest of the chain. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static Node insertAt(Node head, int pos, int value)

It must insert a node holding value at 0-based position pos (0 <= pos <= n; pos 0 replaces the head, pos n appends) and return the head. The harness prints the resulting list space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the roster values in order. Line 3: pos. Line 4: the value to insert.

Output Format:
One line with the resulting list space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 0 <= pos <= n, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Purge Faulty Sensors
questions.description:
Every reading coming from one faulty sensor must be unlinked — not just the first. Sweep the whole chain and repair around each victim. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static Node deleteAll(Node head, int target)

It must unlink EVERY node holding target and return the head. The harness prints the surviving list space-separated; at least one node survives in every test.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the readings in order. Line 3: the value to purge.

Output Format:
One line with the surviving list space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value, target <= 1000

questions.title: Merge Two Sorted Queues
questions.description:
Two sorted dispatch queues must become one sorted queue by relinking the existing nodes — no fresh nodes, no copying values. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static Node mergeTwoSorted(Node a, Node b)

a and b are ascending lists; it must return the head of the merged ascending list built from the same nodes (the left list a wins ties). The harness prints the merged values space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n sorted integers for list a. Line 3: m. Line 4: m sorted integers for list b.

Output Format:
One line with the merged values space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n, m <= 5000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Reverse in K Groups
questions.description:
A scheduler replays log batches in reverse block order: every consecutive group of exactly k nodes is flipped while groups stay in place. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static Node reverseKGroup(Node head, int k)

It must reverse the nodes in consecutive groups of exactly k and return the new head. n is guaranteed to be a multiple of k. The harness prints the result space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n (a multiple of k). Line 2: n space-separated integers — the log values in order. Line 3: k.

Output Format:
One line with the regrouped values space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 1 <= k <= n, n % k == 0, -1000 <= value <= 1000
